data.title: How to read this board
data.body:

Blue numbered callouts match the key note to the right of each image.
Right column: Eva's pick, the counts behind it, the data model, agent actions and extraction rules.

data.title: Artifacts tabs for Relay threads
data.body: A tabbed surface per thread that collects what matters: Linear tickets and GitHub PRs with live status, links, drops and videos, files, Test Bench runs, canvases and subagents. Default tabs come first (Subagents, Links, Media, Everything). Any agent can add, rename, reorder or remove tabs through the agent action registry; Isaac can hide any tab. Desktop: a third panel tool beside Browser and Files. Phone: a sheet from the thread header.

data.title: Eva suggests: a third panel tool, Artifacts
data.body: Put Artifacts beside Browser and Files so links open in the same panel, with the four default tabs in a Mantine Scroller (the SubagentChips pattern). Agents get artifacts.tab.add with rules, not hand-kept lists, and Isaac's Hide always wins. The phone gets the same tabs in a header sheet. Build order: extractor and artifacts.json, Links and Media, Subagents, then agent tabs.

data.title: What real threads hold
data.body:
Mined from message text (prompts excluded), deduped by key.
Astra, Oct 27 (603 msgs): 25 Linear tickets (354 mentions, ENG-6528 alone 82), 10 PRs (314 mentions), 80 drops + 12 pasted images, 14 files, 29 subagents, 1 web link.
Nova, Oct 26 to 27 (598 msgs): 51 drops + 4 pasted images, 17 web links, 5 tickets, 3 PRs, 5 files, 44 subagents, 4 Test Bench runs and 1 canvas (in tool calls).
Code chat 'Build Platform Assets page from prototype', Oct 22 (88 msgs): 9 tickets (43), 10 PRs (49), 2 branches, 2 localhost URLs, 5 drops, 4 subagents.
Takeaway: media and tickets dominate, and dedupe matters more than capture.

data.title: Why tabs in the panel
data.body:
Placement / room / visible with chat / phone / cost
Panel tool (pick) / full height, scrolls / yes, beside the chat / maps to a sheet / medium: new PanelTool 'artifacts'
Context popover section / about 330 px / only while open / no popover on phone / low, but crowds pins and live work
Strip above composer / one row of chips / always / eats phone height / low, but no room for status

data.title: Data model, per thread
Agent actions (registry, like context.pin)
data.body:
artifacts.list {tab?} · what the thread holds, with ids
artifacts.add {kind, url | path, title, tab?} · for things not in a message
artifacts.pin / artifacts.unpin {id} · records pinnedBy
artifacts.tab.add {title, icon?, rule | items} · refused when it duplicates a default or a hidden tab
artifacts.tab.update {id, title?, rule?, items?, order?} · rename, reorder, refile
artifacts.tab.remove {id} · agents remove only tabs they made; Isaac's Hide sets hidden: true and sticks
Scope: the calling session's thread. Each call shows as a tool line in chat.

data.title: Extraction rules
data.body:
Linear: linear.app/<org>/issue/(ENG-\d+) and bare ENG-\d{3,5}, keyed by issue key; state and assignee from the Linear API, cached 5 min.
GitHub PR: github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n>; bare #236 resolves only against the chat's repo (worktree remote or the work item's pr:); gh pr view gives state, draft, review, checks.
GitHub issue: /issues/<n>; other github.com and web URLs land in Links.
Drops: /drops/<uuid>/<token> embeds (alt text = caption) and pasted images; videos get length and poster.
Files: absolute or Eva-relative paths with an extension; images and videos go to Media.
Test Bench: work/experiments/<id>. Canvas: canvases/<slug>.json or page.open canvas.
Branches and worktrees: the chat's worktree and names like fix/ENG-6524-*.
Subagents: task calls and their transcripts.
Skip: the session prompt, w3.org namespaces, localhost unless opened, plain reads in tool calls.
Dedupe: strip trailing punctuation, #comment fragments and tracking params; one row per key.

data.title: Pins and auto-fade
data.body: Unpinned items not mentioned for 7 days leave Links and Everything (search still finds them). Merged PRs and Done tickets fade after 2 days. Finished subagents stay for the day. Pinned items never fade; pinnedBy shows who pinned them.
